description: This file defines an Orleans grain called CountersGrain that implements event sourcing for counting statistics. It includes nested classes for the grain's state, update events, and reset events, as well as methods for managing counters, applying events, and retrieving state information.

classes.name: CountersGrain
classes.description: A grain that counts statistics using event sourcing, maintaining a dictionary of counts per key.

classes.name: CountersGrain.GrainState
classes.description: Represents the state of the grain, consisting of a dictionary of counts for each key, with methods to apply update and reset events.

classes.name: CountersGrain.UpdatedEvent
classes.description: Event representing an update to a counter with a specific key and amount.

classes.name: CountersGrain.ResetAllEvent
classes.description: Event representing a reset of all counters.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Activates the grain, preparing it for use, without waiting for state to load.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Raises an updated event for a specified key and amount, optionally waiting for persistence confirmation.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Raises a reset event to clear all counters, optionally waiting for persistence confirmation.

methods.name: ConfirmAllPreviouslyRaisedEvents
methods.description: Confirms all events that have been raised but not yet persisted.

methods.name: GetTentativeCount
methods.description: Returns the tentative count for a specific key.

methods.name: GetTentativeState
methods.description: Returns the tentative state as a read-only dictionary.

methods.name: GetConfirmedState
methods.description: Returns the confirmed state as a read-only dictionary.

methods.name: GetAllEvents
methods.description: Retrieves all confirmed events from the event log.
